note: Portfolio-level candidate registry. Tracks config files, model sets, and validation metrics for each named portfolio candidate.

candidates.name: quality11_wave4
candidates.notes: First config to pass all promotion gates. 60-day shadow +10.93% on 7-symbol basket. Superseded by quality11_wave5 for new deployments (drift), but config is still valid for wave4 artifacts.

candidates.name: quality11_wave5
candidates.notes: Retrained on train_extended (2017-2025-09-30) to close 22-month drift gap. Governance reset 2026-04-28: v2exp23/24 sidecars are not canonical explicit-symbol evidence because saved recent actions include train-universe symbols. Demoted to paper-live; superseded by quality13_wave5 only as a paper-live candidate, not a live champion.

candidates.name: quality13_wave5
candidates.promotion_gate_concentration_note: Governance reset 2026-04-28: prior PASS used max_concentration_pct=31.0 and sidecars that were not canonical explicit-symbol 7-asset evidence. Strict 30.0 concentration and forward-paper/live-safety gates are required before any live-champion status.
candidates.notes: Governance reset 2026-04-28: demoted from live-champion to paper-live-candidate. Canonical explicit-symbol 7-asset OOS is v2exp25/v2exp26 only: base daily Sharpe 9.84 PF 8.35 DD 1.01% concentration 27.83%; stress daily Sharpe 8.55 PF 7.26 DD 0.84% concentration 25.78%. Prior v2exp23/v2exp24 sidecars included train-universe symbols and are not canonical 7-symbol evidence. Requires live-safety gates and >=30 calendar days forward paper/demo logs before promotion.

candidates.name: quality12_nocars
candidates.notes: Tested 2026-04-25. Removing CARS (cross_asset_relative_strength) caused post_extension_snapback to absorb freed capacity: concentration 35.6% (fails 30% gate), val PF 3.73 (fails 4.0 gate), val DD 4.37% (3x worse than quality11). CARS is a portfolio diversifier, not just a signal source. Retired.

retirement_policy.description: A portfolio candidate is retired when: (1) it fails ≥2 promotion gate checks on the primary OOS split, (2) it is dominated on all metrics by a newer candidate, OR (3) its model_set has been superseded and the config has not been validated with the new model_set.
retirement_policy.split_consumption_rule: A split is considered consumed once it has been used in >10 backtest iterations during research. val and 2026q1 are consumed as of 2026-04-25. The replacement OOS for val/2026q1 is newasset_oos2y (fresh 7-symbol basket). When newasset_oos2y is also consumed, the next replacement is the 2026-Q2 period (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30).
retirement_policy.champion_succession: A candidate becomes live-champion only when: strict promotion gate PASS with non-empty canonical explicit-symbol fresh_oos_label, live-safety tests pass, no real-money safety blockers remain, and ≥30 calendar days forward paper/demo logs complete with positive equity and no reconciliation drift.
